108 engagements

HAYKALAH builds ventures as an institutional co-founder that shares the risk through equity.

Ventures, technology apps and platforms account for 108 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. HAYKALAH joins founders, investors and international companies as an institutional co-founder: we validate the idea, form the company, build the platform with partners and prepare it for capital. Part of our reward is equity that vests as the venture passes agreed gates. HAYKALAH’s own ventures include AS3A, an operating flexible-work platform, and Arsann, which HAYKALAH’s founder built and sold in 2023.

Archive census counts are indicative.

What we do

  • Validation: market research, a feasibility study and HOAM screening.

  • Company formation, sector approvals and Saudization planning.

  • Platform and technology builds, in-house and with partners.

  • Go-to-market: pricing, a sales playbook and the first client agreements.

  • Capital readiness: a three-statement model, valuation, due-diligence report, investor pack and data room.

  • Governance: shareholders’ agreements, boards and trackers for conditions precedent.

  • Equity-for-build terms, with partner equity vesting at milestones.

How we create value

    For German companies entering the Kingdom, we designed Saudi entities co-founded with a German localization partner, with partner equity vesting at registration, the first revenue contract and a KPI threshold (final draft).

  • 03

Questions

Which ventures has HAYKALAH built?

HAYKALAH’s own ventures include AS3A, a flexible-work platform that is operating; Cyber HAYKALAH, a cybersecurity venture; AGTI., its AI precision-farming sub-brand; and Arsann, a parking operator that HAYKALAH’s founder built and sold in 2023.

What are kill criteria?

Conditions agreed at the start of a venture build under which the venture stops. They make sure each gate ends in a clear decision to continue, raise, scale or exit.

Can HAYKALAH’s reward be equity instead of fees?

Yes, in part. HAYKALAH is paid through a retainer, a success fee or equity-for-build, alone or combined, so that its reward follows the venture’s progress.

Bring the idea, the plan or the company you have started. We can start under an NDA.
